name: Indigo Plateau League Reception
summary: Step through the grand double doors into Indigo Plateau, the supreme citadel of the Pokémon League. Utilize the Pokémon Center to heal, the PC storage terminal to assemble your definitive 6-member squad, and the League Mart to purchase essential battle supplies.

items.name: League Mart Inventory
items.method: Purchase Full Restores ($3,000), Max Potions ($2,500), Revives ($1,500), and Full Heals ($600) from the League Clerk
